title: Bound on identified frequency size
statement: Let $n,m\ge0$, let $\pi\colon\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,\ldots,m\}$ be a map, and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Form the set of those target indices $j$ for which the number of elements of $S$ mapped to $j$ is odd. The cardinality of this set is at most $|S|$.
